learn.title: Repeating work
learn.body: A loop repeats code. A `while` loop checks a condition, runs its block if the condition is true, then checks again. It stops the first time the condition is false.

learn.title: Count to three
learn.body: The variable `i` changes each time round.

learn.title: Three things to get right
learn.body: A working loop needs a starting value, a condition that eventually becomes false, and a change inside the block that moves towards that. Here `i` starts at 1, the test is `i <= 3`, and `i++` moves it along.

learn.title: Infinite loops
learn.body: If you forget `i++`, `i` stays 1 and the condition is always true. The loop never ends, and the program seems frozen. In a terminal you can stop it with Control and C.

learn.title: Adding digits
learn.body: `n % 10` is the last digit and `n /= 10` drops it.

learn.title: Tracing the digit sum
steps: Pass 1: add 2, so `sum` is 2, and `n` becomes 47
Pass 2: add 7, so `sum` is 9, and `n` becomes 4
Pass 3: add 4, so `sum` is 13, and `n` becomes 0
The test `n > 0` is now false, so the loop ends

learn.body: To debug a loop, write the variable values for each pass on paper, like the example above.

questions.prompt: When does a `while` loop check its condition?
questions.explanation: It tests first, so the block may run zero times.

questions.prompt: How many numbers does the counting loop print? `i = 1; while (i <= 3)` with `i++`. Type the number.
questions.explanation: It prints 1, 2 and 3, then `i` becomes 4 and the test fails.

questions.prompt: What happens if `i++` is missing from the counting loop?
questions.explanation: `i` never changes, so `i <= 3` stays true forever.

questions.prompt: A loop that never stops is called an \_\_ loop.
`int n = 472;` The digit sum loop adds each digit. What is the total? Type the number.
`int i = 5; while (i < 3) { ... }` How many times does the block run?
questions.explanation: The condition is false at the start, so the block never runs.

questions.prompt: Put the loop idea in order.
questions.explanation: The test happens before every pass, including after the change.
